description: Accept a mission by template_id from list_missions (mission_id works as alias). Ship must be IDLE, DOCKED or ON_MISSION. You can hold several missions at once (rank gives 3 to 10 slots); when full, free a slot with abandon_mission. If the goods exceed your hold, deliver in parts with complete_mission; bought ore does not count for mining missions.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

mission_id.description: Alias of template_id (if both are sent they must be equal).

name: accept_mission
title: Accept mission
